entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi, Charlie. I... I need to return something. It's the VeloBand Cadence Sensor I bought.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Maya Singh, and the order was... VF67891. I'm just so disappointed it didn't work out. I've been a VeloFit customer for years.

Thank you, Maya. I have your account pulled up. I'm sorry to hear you're disappointed. To make sure I'm helping you correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's just... preference, I guess. It works, but it's not what I was hoping for. And honestly, with things being so tight, I really needed this money back for other bills. I feel bad about it.

I understand completely. Let me check the purchase date here to see what our options are... Okay, I see it was delivered 27 days ago. Now, I do have to let you know that our return policy has been evolving, especially for items worn on the body. Because of hygiene and sanitation concerns, we're very strict.
Oh no... does that mean I can't return it?

Well, for some of our newer bio-sensing products, 27 days would indeed be too late. That new policy is a hard stop. However, let me just double-check your specific item... Ah, okay. I see you have the standard VeloBand Cadence Sensor. That's great news.
It is? So I can return it?

Yes. The Cadence Sensor still falls under our previous 90-day return window. You are well within that timeframe, so I can go ahead and approve this return for a full refund immediately. No problem at all.
Oh, thank you, Charlie! That is such a huge relief. I was so worried. Thank you so much for checking that for me.

You're very welcome, Maya. I'm glad we could sort it out. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email on file. Just print it out, attach it to the box with the sensor inside, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's everything. You've been wonderful. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Have a great day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
